label: PRESPECIFIED_CONTROLLED_STUDY_NOT_REPLACEMENT_FROZEN_VERDICT
runtime_change: None intended; CI manual-dispatch addition only. New head/binary must be bound before launch.

scope.warmup: Two complete fixed 16-cell sweeps per server, same order/requests/settings as measured sweep; no speed-dependent warmup or sample discard.
scope.candidate_order: BF16 then8bit in even rounds;8bit thenBF16 in odd rounds; unchanged plain brackets each pair.

controls: Independent plain-before/plain-after launches per round; complete global GPU/thermal coverage. No existing qualification cell is removed or overwritten. No thermal/power override, competing-process kill, pressure override or repetition for a better sign.

acceptance.candidate: Every32 candidate comparison has observed median loss<1% and one-sided95% Student-t lower bound for paired log TPS ratio above log(0.99). Six independent launch-round ratios, df5; tcritical2.015048373333.
acceptance.paired_reference: Geometric mean of the two same-round plain controls; both candidates same reference.
acceptance.aa_validity: For every16 cell,90% two-sided Student-t interval of plain-after/plain-before log ratio wholly inside [log(0.99),log(1.01)]. Failure invalidates fine-grained performance clearance; do not drop controls or rerun for a better sign.
acceptance.assumptions: Student-t model over independent launch-round log ratios; no claim of a universal noise floor or proof of stationarity. Global thermal observations and individual A/A ratios published.
acceptance.correctness: Every512-token warmup/measured request must match the original same-prompt/temp/seed token hash and pass unchanged client problems/pressure guards.

failure_behavior: Stop on correctness, process, source binding, or pressure failure; retain every attempted launch and clean up only owned children. No automatic restart/retry. Statistical or A/A failure reported without relabelling it a confirmed software regression.
